svg.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Brokerage
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Brokerage; subtitle: Prepare the operating system without forcing premature live loads.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. This sprint prepares launch readiness; it does not replace the canonical 2–6 month time-to-first-deal planning range or accelerate external authority processing.; caption: Finish the month with a documented niche, tracked authority work, tested verification procedures, and a cash-limited pipeline. Live brokerage begins only when required authority and operating prerequisites are satisfied.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define niche, economics, and authority work; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose equipment and lane boundaries, identify 50 target shippers, document the three canonical scorecard scenarios, obtain security quotes, and prepare required registration and process-agent work.; label: Days 8-14; value: Configure verification and transaction records; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure the TMS, Highway or RMIS workflow, trusted callback procedure, carrier document checklist, and 49 CFR 371.3 record retention. Test identity and bank-change exceptions using synthetic records.; label: Days 15-21; value: Test quoting, credit, and cash timing; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Conduct shipper discovery, assemble carrier coverage options, and model sample quotes without representing pending authority as active. Stress-test payment gaps and set account exposure limits against available cash.; label: Days 22-30; value: Rehearse shipment execution and reconciliation; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Run a synthetic tender-to-settlement exercise, assign the five core seats, test tracking alerts and duplicate invoice detection, and review authority status. Keep live loads paused while required prerequisites remain open.

text.title: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Brokerage
text.tspan: Thirty Days to an Evidence-Ready Brokerage

circle.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define niche, economics, and authority work; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose equipment and lane boundaries, identify 50 target shippers, document the three canonical scorecard scenarios, obtain security quotes, and prepare required registration and process-agent work.

text.title: Define niche, economics, and authority work

circle.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Configure verification and transaction records; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure the TMS, Highway or RMIS workflow, trusted callback procedure, carrier document checklist, and 49 CFR 371.3 record retention. Test identity and bank-change exceptions using synthetic records.

label: Days 15-21; value: Test quoting, credit, and cash timing; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Conduct shipper discovery, assemble carrier coverage options, and model sample quotes without representing pending authority as active. Stress-test payment gaps and set account exposure limits against available cash.

text.title: Test quoting, credit, and cash timing

circle.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Rehearse shipment execution and reconciliation; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Run a synthetic tender-to-settlement exercise, assign the five core seats, test tracking alerts and duplicate invoice detection, and review authority status. Keep live loads paused while required prerequisites remain open.

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values are milestone end days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. This sprint prepares launch readiness; it does not replace the canonical 2–6 month time-to-first-deal planning range or accelerate external authority processing.
